spec.kitLine: 18 normal hits vs Anti A.T. Field
spec.assertion: Removing any 590.64% flatDamage from skill1 leaves her total BYTE-IDENTICAL — proves the rider is inert with no Anti A.T. Field carrier in the comp. Nearest-wrong (rider wired ungated / status gate dropped) goes RED because removal would drop damage. Non-vacuity supplied by a second run that ADDS an ungated hitCount:18 copy and must exceed baseline by >20%.
it.skip — targetStatus models a named window, not a stack pool; no consumer of the stack exists in this kit.

Delta-vs-delta: deltaShipped (baseline − rider-removed) must be >5% and <60% of deltaUngated (ungated-copy-added − baseline). Proves the rider is LIVE and confined to the ~10 s post-burst Attack-State windows. Nearest-wrong (whole-fight hitCount:7 with no self-status gate) makes the two deltas ~equal → RED. Second nearest-wrong (line dropped entirely) → removal delta 0 → RED.

No distinct casterAtkPct magnitude in the whole event log sits at ratio 17.6/11.61 = 1.51593 vs her skill2 magnitude — proves the Annihilation-State-scoped ATK buff is not credited to a team that has no Annihilation State. Nearest-wrong (target modelled as plain `allies`) introduces exactly that ratio → RED. Non-vacuity: the added ungated block DOES produce the ratio and raises team damage.
it.skip — neither the affected-unit count nor the attack range of a foreign unit's additional effect is an engine primitive.
it.skip — no MG ramp-up StatKey (the wind-up ladder is a measured constant with no buff channel) and the target set (MG ∧ has-burst) is inexpressible; inert in the fixture anyway (no MG present).

buffApply count === allyCount × fullBurstStart count, target set === every ally incl. self, one caster index, durationShots unset, emitted value ≠ the raw 11.61. Discriminates: burstCast keying (count would be allyCount × herCasts, strictly fewer — the fixture asserts fbStarts > herCasts), atkPct scaling (raw 11.61 on the event — verified RED by the stat-flip counterfactual), and round-count duration.

Exactly herBurstCasts attackDamagePct events, all targetSlug === her slug, raw value 35.9, durationShots unset. Nearest-wrong (target `allies`) → teammates receive it; the counterfactual proves that would raise every teammate's total, so the self-only claim is non-vacuous.

Identified stat-independently as the casterAtkPct magnitude at ratio 5.45736 vs the skill2 magnitude; all its applications target her slug only and its count is strictly less than the Full-Burst count (burst-cast keyed, not FB-enter keyed). Emitted value ≠ raw 63.36 (caster-scaled flat ATK).

Exactly one 990.2% flatDamage exists in the burst slot; removing it lowers HER total and leaves every teammate byte-identical. Plus: every damage event with srcSlot 'burst' has fbMajorApplied falsy — burst-cast damage lands before the Full Burst window (no +50%), the nearest-wrong being a burst nuke keyed to fullBurstEnter.

fixtures: controlComp('rei-ayanami-tentative-name', true) for all 9 runs — liter B1 / crown B2 / rei B3 / helm B3, deterministic (no seed). The fixed second Burst III is load-bearing: a lone B3 makes zero Full Bursts, and more importantly the extra B3 lets a Full Burst complete WITHOUT her cast, so fullBurstEnter-keyed lines (skill2) and burst-cast-keyed lines (her burst self buffs) have different activation counts — asserted explicitly (fbStarts > herBurstCasts) so the trigger-identity assertions are not vacuous. No ATK/stat constant is hardcoded: her two caster-scaled ATK magnitudes are identified purely by the kit ratio 63.36/11.61, so the file is immune to fixture stat changes. 9 hoisted runs: baseline + 8 counterfactuals (Anti A.T. Field removed / ungated, Attack-State rider removed / ungated, Annihilation ATK ungated, skill2 casterAtkPct→atkPct, burst self→allies, burst nuke removed).
gaps: skill1 a `Anti A.T. Field stacks ▲10` — it.skip: no status-stack primitive (targetStatus is a named duration window only) and no consumer in this kit.
skill1 c `Units affected by Annihilation State's additional effect ▲1` — it.skip: no engine primitive for another unit's effect fan-out.
skill1 c `Attack range of Annihilation State's additional effect ▲500%` — it.skip: no engine primitive for effect attack range.

skill2 a `Machine Gun Ramp-Up Speed ▲100% for 13 sec` — it.skip: no ramp-up StatKey (the MG wind-up ladder is a measured constant with no buff channel), and the target set (allies with MG ∧ who have cast their burst) is inexpressible (burstCasters has no weapon facet; alliesOfWeapon has no burst-cast facet). Inert in the fixture regardless — no MG unit present.

Per-rider noFb / noRange conventions on both skill1 riders — it.skip: not attributable from the event log without a unit identity on the damage event; MEASUREMENT-GATED (popup read), so not asserted blind.

Encoding uncertainty (reported, not asserted): the packet's harness note and the override-shape note disagree on whether an override slot is a bare Block[] or a { blocks: Block[] } wrapper — slotBlocks() handles both. Likewise cfg.onEvent is attached BOTH top-level and under cfg so the event tap binds under either shape.

Modelling ambiguity (reported): `Attack State` is a SELF status with no self-status gate primitive; the only faithful encodings available are a name-keyed targetStatus window opened by her burst (semantically enemy-held) or an equivalent 10 s burst-cast-keyed gate. The test asserts the OBSERVABLE (rider confined to her post-burst windows), so it is encoding-agnostic.
